title: Brewer  -  Three Bottles for the Road
design_overview:
Brewer  -  Three Bottles for the Road

**Premise and dialogue:** Prepare a small travelling batch. “A good brew starts with a place to work and the right ingredients. Mark my stand and we'll make three bottles together. This batch is on me.”

**Existing:** registered brewing-route discovery, stand processing, exact potion contents, finite Brew 3 configuration, ingredients/fuel, collection and deposit. Use a runtime-validated regular potion route. Base Swiftness is a suitable default fixture only if the running recipe catalog confirms it; no invented or hard-coded pack-independent recipe.

steps.title: 1 Accept the demonstration
steps.design_check: reserve BREWING player/job record and bind worker.
steps.design_provisions: free three-bottle assignment and shared Clipboard if needed.
steps.design_notes:
1 Accept the demonstration

**Tutor:** “We'll make three bottles together. This first batch is on me.”

**Task:** Choose the proposed free lesson.

**Check:** reserve BREWING player/job record and bind worker.

**Provides:** free three-bottle assignment and shared Clipboard if needed.

steps.title: 2 Mark the stand

cards.text: Open {Inventory}. Right-click the Clipboard slot until it reads Edit Job Site, then close the inventory. With it in your hand, point at our brewing stand and press {Use}.

See the box? Scroll to move it, or hold {ControlModifier} while scrolling to make it wider or narrower. Hold {ShiftModifier} and scroll to change its height position; {ControlModifier} and {AltModifier} together change its height. Include the work and a clear way to reach it.
When the box fits, point at me, your Brewer, and press {Use} without sneaking. Show me the area you chose.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Preview our brewing stand, then acknowledge the actual saved area on the bound Brewer. Do not complete for moving or merely displaying the box.
sequences.recovery: That is only the draft until you apply it to me. If it is in the wrong place, point at the right centre and use the Clipboard again. To start fresh, hold {Sneak} and press {Attack} on a block in Edit Job Site, then redraw. Keep protected or unrelated work outside.

steps.design_objective: Apply an area containing a brewing stand.
steps.design_check: persisted area, matching dimension, loaded supported station and reachable interaction position according to the worker's own station search.
steps.design_provisions: stand loan or existing demonstration stand, plus exact access/conflicting-contents feedback.
steps.design_notes:
2 Mark the stand

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Open {Inventory}. Right-click the Clipboard slot until it reads Edit Job Site, then close the inventory. With it in your hand, point at our brewing stand and press {Use}.”
2. “See the box? Scroll to move it, or hold Control while scrolling to make it wider or narrower. Hold Shift and scroll to change its height position; Control and Alt together change its height. Include the work and a clear way to reach it.”
3. “When the box fits, point at me, your Brewer, and press {Use} without sneaking. Show me the area you chose.”

**Show / confirm:** Preview our brewing stand, then acknowledge the actual saved area on the bound Brewer. Do not complete for moving or merely displaying the box.

**If it goes wrong:** “That is only the draft until you apply it to me. If it is in the wrong place, point at the right centre and use the Clipboard again. To start fresh, hold {Sneak} and press {Attack} on a block in Edit Job Site, then redraw. Keep protected or unrelated work outside.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Show me the brewing stand, with room to reach it.”

**Task:** Apply an area containing a brewing stand.

**Check:** persisted area, matching dimension, loaded supported station and reachable interaction position according to the worker's own station search.

**Provides:** stand loan or existing demonstration stand, plus exact access/conflicting-contents feedback.

steps.title: 3 Assign supplies and finished potions

cards.text: Open {Inventory} and right-click the Clipboard slot until a storage mode appears. Close the inventory and hold your Clipboard. Hold {ControlModifier} and scroll until it says Assign Supplies.
Point at the supplies chest and press {Use}. That selects the chest; it has not assigned it yet.
Now point at me, your Brewer, and press {Use} without sneaking. Click Assign Clipboard Storage in the menu. Show me that last step.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Identify this lesson’s supplies chest and named tutor. Show selection first, then acknowledge only the stored Supplies link for this worker. Opening the menu is an intermediate checkpoint.
sequences.recovery: If you selected the wrong chest, close the menu, aim into empty air, hold {Sneak} and press {Use} with the Clipboard to clear the selection. Select the right chest and choose Assign Clipboard Storage again. If you cannot open the chest to load it, put the Clipboard away first.

steps.title: 4 Order the exact batch

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.

Click Configure Brewing. Select the potion named in our lesson card, then its offered level, duration and form choices for that exact validated route. Choose Brew 3 at the amount choice. Show me the order before we run it.
Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Show the runtime-supported potion name, level, duration, form and three-bottle amount at each matching menu; confirm the stored route/order. Do not promise nonexistent route options or silently select an alternative.
sequences.recovery: If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.

steps.design_objective: Open Configure Brewing, select the validated regular potion and Brew 3.
steps.design_check: actual selected route, output components and finite quantity.
steps.design_provisions: three filled water bottles, route ingredients and enough supported fuel once; calculate from actual route. Display the material bill. Filled bottles keep an unverified water-filling action out of the mandatory sequence.

steps.title: 5 Brew, do not merely wait nearby

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on me, then choose Job and Work Settings.
Choose Ask for Work Report first. If work is paused, click Start/Pause Work once. Leave it alone if work is already enabled, then close the conversation so I can work.
Show me those settings. We will begin once they are right.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Confirm work-enabled authority for this finite trial and show the real next worker action. Starting work is not evidence that the harvest, craft or delivery succeeded.
sequences.recovery: If you opened the Clipboard storage menu, close it and put the Clipboard away before talking to me again. If Job is unavailable, the lesson must restore your trial assignment; do not buy a paid hire to get past the tutorial.

steps.design_objective: Enable work and observe actual stage transitions.
steps.design_check: this assignment's ingredients are loaded and transformed through the selected stand route.
steps.design_provisions: current stage, remaining inputs and honest vanilla timer/status explanations; no timer skip or refill.

steps.title: 6 Deliver and report

cards.text: Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the output chest to open it and look at what arrived.
Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Brewer, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.

sequences.confirmation_guidance: Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.
sequences.recovery: If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.

steps.design_objective: Inspect Output, then speak to the brewer.
steps.design_check: three correctly component-matched potions attributable to this assignment were deposited; stop further free brewing.
steps.design_notes:
6 Deliver and report

**Teach and demonstrate (spoken in order):**
1. “Put the Clipboard away. With an empty hand, press {Use} on the output chest to open it and look at what arrived.”
2. “Close the chest, then press {Use} on me, your Brewer, with an empty hand. Return to our lesson conversation.”

**Show / confirm:** Show the attributable delivered goods and actual remaining amount. Reopening a chest or saying “done” never substitutes for the delivery receipt.

**If it goes wrong:** “If it is empty, leave room in the output chest and ask me for a Work Report under Job → Work Settings. Follow the missing supplies, blocked path or full-output hint; moving your own matching items into it will not complete my work.”


**Optional flavour line:** “Three bottles, ready for the road. Shall we look at my usual rate?”

**Task:** Inspect Output, then speak to the brewer.

**Check:** three correctly component-matched potions attributable to this assignment were deposited; stop further free brewing.

**Provides/reward:** those three real potions and a saved lesson summary. “Three bottles ready. Shall I keep brewing? I'll show you my usual price.” Apply shared paid/stop ending.

**A Continue working:** “Show me your normal price.” Present the current role, duration, currency and total. Start ordinary paid work only after the player accepts a still-valid quote.

**B Stop here:** “Thanks. Stop working.” End this tutorial assignment safely, reconcile its output and identifiable loans, and keep the lesson completed. Dismissal leaves work paused.


**New hooks:** committed-area/station validation; route selection; station allocation identity; stage transformation, collection and deposit attribution. Carry identity across multiple brewing stages and partial transfers. A generic WORKING state or practice event cannot prove final delivery.
